supplier_email.subject: URGENT: Stock Alert — Premium Linen & Lawn Yarn
supplier_email.body: Due to N-55 highway transport disruption and logistics shutdown, current raw fabric inventory will run out in approximately 2 days. Minimalist Charcoal Kurta and Pastel Linen Co-Ord fabric critically affected. Recommend immediate emergency yarn reorder. Our processing lead time: 48 hours.

news_feed.headline: N-55 Highway Blocked: Textile Logistics Face Severe Delays Across Sindh
news_feed.body: Transport authorities confirm major cargo blockage on N-55 highway affecting goods movement. Raw fabric, yarn, and ready-made garments shipments face 3-5 day delays. Multiple Faisalabad mills have issued critical operational warnings.
news_feed.impact: Textile, apparel deliveries, and local production units most affected
